## 进决策箱 —— 并补上作者说「裁决前值得先测」的那个读数

由 `domain:devx` @ objectui 执行席(#5748)记录,PM 会话 `session_012CZgmFFzqA9cX8tBMhvpFe`,R30。⛔ 我不设 `domain:*` —— 路由归分诊席。挂 `needs-user-decision` 的理由在最后一节:这是 **PR #6345 的落地闸门**,不只是一张后续卡。

### 先复核事实(我自己在 `origin/main` 上跑的,不是转述)

| 读数 | 结果 |
|:--|:--|
| `MenuItem.onClick` 是否声明 | ✅ `packages/types/src/overlay.ts:346` |
| 三个菜单渲染器是否读 `onClick` | ⛔ **零命中** |
| 它们读什么 | `item.onSelect` —— `context-menu.tsx:65`、`dropdown-menu.tsx:67`;`menubar.tsx` **两个都不读** |

探针可信,因为同一条 grep 在同样的文件里命中了 `onSelect` —— 零命中是读数,不是漏查。

### ⭐ 作者点名「取决于野外有没有 authored `onSelect`」—— 测了,是 0

```
git grep -rn '"onSelect"' origin/main -- examples content/docs apps   →  0 命中
```

**对照(证明我扫的地方不是空的)**:同一批目录里确实存在菜单 schema —— `components-overlay-context-menu/basic-context-menu.json`、`components-overlay-dropdown-menu/{basic,with-icons}.json`、`components-overlay-menubar/application-menubar.json`。所以「0」是「这些菜单 schema 一个都没写 `onSelect`」,不是「没扫到菜单」。

⚠️ 边界要说清:这测的是**本仓**。仓外消费者无法从类型学到 `onSelect`(它没被声明),只能靠读渲染器源码,所以外部使用不太可能 —— 但**不是不可能**,而我测不到。

### 四维分析

**① 实际业务需求.** 选项 A 唯一的成本是「已写 `onSelect` 的作者会失效」,而这个成本在本仓**实测为 0**。反过来,今天真实存在的伤害是:一个照着已发布类型写 `onClick` 的作者,**校验通过、发布通过、然后什么都不发生**。前者是假想成本,后者是现成的。

**② 项目长远合理性.** 北极星是 declared = enforced。A 让实现向已发布契约收敛;B 让契约向实现让步,并且**移动一个已发布类型**(`MenuItem.onClick` 已经在 dist 里、在 zod 镜像里)。契约跟着实现跑,下次实现再漂,契约再跟一次 —— 那不是收敛。

**③ 防 AI 写代码犯错.** 这一轴最硬,而且指向 A。AI 写元数据 app 时读的就是**类型**。`onClick` 声明在那里,AI 会用它,拿到一个静默无效的菜单 —— 卡片自己的话:「能通过校验、能发布、然后静默什么都不做」。B 修好了这一点,但代价是把 AI 从没读过的那个拼写扶正,同时让今天所有照类型写的人失效。A 是唯一让「读类型 → 能用」成立的选项。

**④ 创业阶段不扩散需求.** A 改三个渲染器 + 一个 helper 的类型(`renderMenuItems(items: any[])` → `MenuItem[]`),不动已发布面,不新增能力。B 要动已发布类型 + zod 镜像 + 刚由 PR #6345 落的三个文档页。A 明显更省。C 已被卡片正文以 #4453/#5329/#6107 三次先例否掉,我同意。

⭐ 顺带:把 helper 从 `any[]` 收成 `MenuItem[]` 本身就是这个 bug 能存在的原因 —— 它是让「声明与实现不一致」得以 type-check 通过的那道口子。A 顺手关掉它。

### PM 推荐:**A**

理由压在 ①③ 上:A 的迁移成本在本仓实测为零,而它是唯一让「照已发布类型写」这件事真正работа的选项。⛔ 推荐是输入不是放行。

⚠️ 若你选 **B**,连带项已经点名:PR #6345 刚把三个文档页指向 `onClick`,B 之下它们要跟着改回来 —— 这是把一张已合并的文档 PR 再翻一次,成本要算进 B。

### ⛔ 这张卡是 PR #6345 的落地闸门

PR #6345 **照裁决字面执行是对的**(裁决的判据是「declared」,`onClick` 满足它;它点名要防的「指向第二个未声明的 prop」也没有发生)。但实施中测出了**对向事实**:那个重定向目标声明存在、运行时无人读取。按本席技能对这种情形的规定 —— 照字面执行、冲突立成决策卡、**该 PR 不挂 auto-merge、留异议窗口** —— PR #6345 **保持 draft、未武装**,等你在这里落一句。

Refs: PR #6345 · #6132(裁决所在)· #6326 / #6278(同族的 `MenuItem` 缺陷)

## Maintainer ruling recorded — Option A: the type is the contract; all three renderers read `onClick`

Provenance: maintainer, 2026-08-27, PM chat decision-inbox batch 5 (adjudication session `session_01DKWDdUJ2XNRESVVWUvcpnh`), verbatim: 「同意」 — accepting recommendation A (seat 2026-08-25T14:37Z analysis + triage facet block), ruled in one sitting with #6523 as both cards asked: one answer for the whole `MenuItem` family.

Ruled: all three menu renderers read the declared `item.onClick` (dropdown/context switch off the undeclared `onSelect`; menubar — which currently wires no handler at all — gains the wiring); `renderMenuItems` tightens from `any[]` to `MenuItem[]`, closing the hole that let the divergence type-check. Migration cost measured zero in-repo (authored `onSelect`: 0 hits with firing positive controls). ⛔ C (both spellings, one deprecated) stays refused per the three standing precedents.

Consequences released by this ruling: **PR #6345 (the three doc pages naming `onClick`) is un-gated** — the redirect target is confirmed the contract; the PR proceeds on its normal path. Tripwire: if implementation surfaces external authored `onSelect` corpus, stop and report — do not widen to dual-dialect silently.

Dispatch notes: family dispatch with #6523 permitted if the five fold gates pass (same interface, same renderer set, both ruled, per-card pins, exclusion list stated); Clause-② rides the #6523 half (the union type change) — this half changes renderer reads to match the published type.

State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`.

Claim: `domain:ui` @ objectui PM seat, session `8ca04858-ea8e-5b85-9182-de59aa49e00c` — branch `claude/issue-6523-menuitem-separator-family`.

⭐ **Dispatched as a family with #6523, one dev, one branch, on the maintainer's instruction.** Both cards were ruled in a single sitting on 2026-08-27 as *"one answer for the whole `MenuItem` family"*, and #6523's ruling states: *"Family dispatch with #6346 permitted under the five fold gates; each card keeps its own `Fixes` and pins."*

So this card is **not** queued behind #6523 — they land together. ⛔ But they are not merged into one deliverable either: this card keeps its **own** `Fixes #6346` and its **own** pins. The family is a dispatch unit, not a scope merge.

The dispatch order sends the dev to read **this card's own ruling** rather than inferring it from #6523's — the two decide different keys of the same interface (this one the handler dialect, #6523 the divider and the shortcut), and a ruling read second-hand is a ruling half-read.

The load-bearing shared fact both halves rest on: `MenuItemSchema` is a bare `z.object`, so an undeclared key is **silently stripped and the parse still reports success** — which is why no gate has ever reported either dialect. That is the same "declared ≠ enforced, and nothing notices" shape this lane keeps meeting, and it is why the fix has to be a declared refusal rather than a renderer-side tolerance.

Clause-② yes, contract-review tier; changeset `minor` with the break spelled out.

ACCEPT — PR #6693, head `c75b928e6`, landed with #6523 on one branch as the ruling authorised. This card keeps its own `Fixes #6346` and its own pins; the family was a dispatch unit, not a scope merge.

## What the measurement found was worse than the card said

The card reported that the menu renderers read an undeclared `item.onSelect` while the declared `MenuItem.onClick` is read by nothing. Confirmed — and the third container was worse:

- `dropdown-menu` and `context-menu` read the **undeclared** `item.onSelect`;
- ⚠️ **`menubar` wired no handler at all.**

So the declared key had *zero* live readers across all three, and one container had no click path whatever. All three now fire the declared `item.onClick`, and `renderMenuItems` / `renderContextMenuItems` tighten from `any[]` to `MenuItem[]` — which is what stops the next undeclared handler spelling from being reachable in the first place.

## ⭐ Why this could only be fixed together with #6523

Both halves rest on one mechanism: `MenuItemSchema` was a bare `z.object`, so **an undeclared key is silently stripped and the parse still reports success**. That is why neither dialect — the divider's nor the handler's — was ever visible to a gate. Fixing one key while the other stayed unjudged would have left the mechanism intact.

The ruling's "one answer for the whole `MenuItem` family" was therefore the right shape, and the union plus the `type` tombstone is what removes the silence for both.

⭐ Evidence that the tombstone does real work: it forced out a **third** undeclared dialect on the same key — `item.type === 'label'`, dead code nobody had named — plus `item.inset`, undeclared and never authored. Both documented as forced consequential cleanups rather than slipped in.

## The ablation on this card's half

Leg B reverted the `onClick` wiring: predicted 6/6 red, first run gave **5/6**. ⭐ The dev root-caused the gap to a bug in its own ablation harness's regex — ⛔ not a renderer defect — fixed the harness and re-ran to a full 6/6. A wrong instrument was not allowed to pass as either a satisfied prediction or a finding about the code.
